pattern_explanation: The Polish word and the English word look alike, but they come from different roots and developed different meanings, so matching them by sight alone leads to mistakes.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Polish word aktualny (transliteration: aktualny) looks like the English word actual, but it means current or up to date. The English word actual means real or genuine, so a Polish speaker may wrongly translate aktualny as actual.
